jobs.title: Town Planning Assistant
jobs.description:
**Powered by Water, Driven by Purpose**


South West Water keeps the South West flowing with safe, reliable drinking water and wastewater services across some of the UK’s most stunning landscapes.


We’re proud to be part of Pennon Group, a leader in the UK water sector, working towards a greener future. Our goals? As well as lowering our carbon footprint, we’re working with partners to plant 300,000 trees, restore peatlands and supporting farmers and landowners to improve water quality and wildlife.


Whether you’re starting out or seeking a new challenge, our scale and ambition create opportunities for you to shape your own career.


Ready to make a splash? **Join our team today.**

**Developer Services \| Exeter \| Hybrid Working**

### **Launch your planning career with South West Water**


Are you a recent Town Planning graduate or an early\-career planning professional looking for an opportunity to develop your skills in a unique and rewarding environment?


We're looking for a **Town Planning Assistant** to join our growing Pre\-Development Team. This is an excellent entry\-level opportunity to gain hands\-on experience within the planning profession while developing a broader understanding of infrastructure, sustainable development and the water industry.


Working alongside experienced planning professionals, engineers and developers, you'll play an important role in helping shape growth across the South West. You'll gain exposure to planning applications, local planning policy, developer engagement and infrastructure planning, building the knowledge and experience needed for a successful planning career.

###### **Why this role is different:**


Most planning careers begin within a local authority or consultancy. This role offers something different.


You'll gain practical experience across the development process while learning how critical infrastructure supports sustainable growth. You'll work with local authorities, developers, consultants and internal specialists, giving you a broad perspective that many planners do not experience early in their careers.


This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to develop towards RTPI chartership and build a long\-term career in planning.

### **What you'll be doing:**

* Supporting the review of planning applications and development proposals.
* Preparing consultation responses on behalf of South West Water.
* Researching planning and site information to support decision\-making.
* Liaising with local planning authorities, developers, agents and customers.
* Assisting with pre\-application enquiries and development consultations.
* Supporting work relating to local plans and emerging planning policy.
* Working closely with colleagues across Developer Services, Asset Protection, Growth and Network teams.
* Learning about the relationship between planning, infrastructure and sustainable development.

### **What we're looking for:**


You'll be someone who is enthusiastic about planning and eager to learn.

###### **Essential**

* Degree in Town Planning or a related discipline (preferably RTPI accredited).
* Understanding of the UK planning system and planning process.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good research and analytical skills.
* Ability to manage and prioritise a varied workload.
* Positive, proactive and solution\-focused approach.
* Interest in developing a professional career in planning.

###### **Desirable**

* Eligibility to work towards Chartered Membership of the RTPI.
* Previous placement, internship or work experience within a planning environment.
* Knowledge of planning policy or development management.

### **Why join us?**


Kick\-start your planning career with South West Water and gain hands\-on experience across planning, development and infrastructure projects that help shape sustainable growth across the South West. With mentoring from experienced professionals, support towards RTPI membership, and structured development opportunities, this is an excellent opportunity to build the skills, experience and confidence needed for a successful career in planning.

* Generous holiday allowance plus bank holidays
* A discretionary Bonus
* Competitive Contributory Pension
* Share\-save Scheme
* Various health benefits
* Wellbeing support programmes
* A range of Group Discounts
* Cycle to Work Scheme

**Closing Date: 17th September 2026**


We may close this vacancy early if we receive a high volume of applications. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

*Please note that the successful candidate will be subject to a mandatory DBS check as part of the onboarding process.*

**Be yourself, we like it that way.** Together, we will build a culture of belonging, where inclusion is instinctive. Diversity is our strength and a reflection of our communities. We care, we value everyone, we celebrate uniqueness.

**Our core values, which are essential to our success, are:**

**Be Rock Solid** \- Build trust and be trusted. Be the one we all look to and can depend on.

**Be You** \- We want you to bring your best everyday. Be yourself and make your mark in your individual way.

**Be the Future** \- Embrace change. Drive Progress. Own the challenge.

**Joining Arup**


Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.


You will join our Newcastle planning team, part of a wider “North” planning network spanning Scotland, the North of England and Northern Ireland. Our planners work on a diverse portfolio of projects, helping shape places, infrastructure and communities through innovative and sustainable development.


Working as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside environmental, transport, design and engineering specialists, you will contribute to projects across sectors including energy, transport, water, science, industry and technology.

  

**The Opportunity**


We are looking for a Town Planner to support the delivery of a wide range of planning projects and help shape sustainable development across the UK.


In this role, you will:


* Support and manage planning applications and development projects, including major and complex schemes


* Contribute to policy development, plan\-making and urban regeneration initiatives


* Prepare and contribute to high\-quality planning reports, statements and technical documents


* Support major infrastructure schemes, including NSIPs and National Developments


* Work closely with clients, stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams to deliver successful outcomes


At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.


You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

  

**Is this role right for you?**


We are looking for people who bring a combination of technical capability, collaboration and a passion for high\-quality planning outcomes:


* A degree in Town Planning (or related discipline) and RTPI membership (or working towards)


* Experience contributing to planning applications and development management projects


* Strong understanding of UK planning legislation, policy and guidance


* Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, high\-quality outputs

### **About The Role**


**Job Title: Senior Planning Officer**  

**Hours: 37 full time post**  

**Salary:** **HC08 £37,563 \- £42,123 per annum ( NJC Pay structure 26\-27\)**  

**Contract: Permanent**  

**Closing date: 2 October 2026**


**The Role**



Herefordshire Council are seeking to recruit a Senior Planning Officer (a permanent full\-time 37 hours per week post)



The successful applicant will be an ambitious town planner seeking to gain further experience within Development Management and take their career to the next level or someone with senior level experience simply looking to work in a beautiful part of the world and with a great team.


Read the full advert to understand how you could play a key role in shaping a sustainable and greener future for Herefordshire residents and its economy.


**What will you be doing?**



You will be based within one of the two area teams and the role will involve you in some of the more significant planning (and associated) applications that we deal with.



You will work within the beautiful Herefordshire countryside as well as dealing with casework within the city of Hereford and/or its surrounding market towns and villages.



The County is rich in biodiversity, landscape and heritage value including two National Landscapes, Conservation Areas and many listed building buildings. We think it\`s a truly outstanding place to work, that will offer the right candidate valuable experience in a wide range of casework and challenges, as well as an opportunity to shape a sustainable future as the Council embarks on the preparation of a new Local Plan.


**About You**



As a Senior Planning Officer you will have:


* An understanding of the role of a Senior Planning Officer in a local planning authority and demonstrable experience of dealing with a range of planning and other associated applications.
* Strong knowledge of planning policy, regulatory issues and current legislation.
* The ability to work under your own initiative as well as within a team, often to tight deadlines and on multiple work streams.
* Membership of or be or actively working towards membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute.
* A current full driving licence. Pool Cars are available for use.
* Please note we do not provide sponsorship for employment in the UK.


**We Offer**



 A competitive salary, holiday entitlement, and access to our contributory pension and staff benefits scheme, which includes:


* Salary range of £37,563 \- £42,123
* Enrolment in the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS)
* Career progression: clear pathways to progress
* Annual Leave: 31 days’ annual leave (pro rata) plus bank holidays. You can also purchase an additional 10 days per annum during the request period
* Flexible working: including the potential for job\-sharing, part\-time hours and agile working.
* Employee Assistance Programme: 24/7 access to support and counselling
* Payment of professional membership fees (based on role requirements)
* Pick your perks – our benefits include access to a range of retail, leisure, holiday and health benefits. This includes savings, cash back and discounts.


**Why Choose Us?**



We're proud and excited to unveil our new recruitment video, a celebration of Herefordshire's people, places, and purpose. Set in the heart of England and filled with pride, compassion and possibility, the video brings to life what it means to work somewhere you truly belong.



At Herefordshire Council, every role matters and every person makes a real difference for our communities. We’re a team where people feel valued, supported and empowered to grow together.



Herefordshire is big hearted, welcoming and friendly. We have strong and independent communities and idyllic countryside, situated in the South West Midlands and bordering Wales. The county sits between Worcestershire and the Malvern Hills to the east, and Bannau Brycheiniog (the Brecon Beacons) in Wales to the west.



Historically Herefordshire has been the gateway to the Marches. We embrace partnership working. We are a member of the Marches Forward Partnership, which is a cross border collaboration between Herefordshire, Monmouthshire, Powys and Shropshire who are collectively working to secure funding to invest in the region.



The council priorities over the next four years are set out in the Council Plan, with four main areas;


**People**: We will enable residents to realise their potential, to be healthy and to be part of great communities who support each other. We want all children to have the best start in life.


**Place**: We will protect and enhance our environment and ensure that Herefordshire is a great place to live. We will support the right housing in the right place, we will support access to green spaces and we will do everything we can to recover the health of our rivers.


**Growth**: We will create the conditions to deliver sustainable growth across the county; attracting inward investment, building business confidence, creating jobs, enabling housing development along with providing the right infrastructure.


**Transformation:** We will be an efficient council that embraces best practice, delivers innovation through technology and demonstrates value for money.


**Don’t meet all parts of the job description?**



Herefordshire Council is committed to strengthening a diverse and inclusive work environment which reflects the communities of Herefordshire. If you are looking at the next stage of your career and have a broad base of fieldwork experience, we can provide supportive and welcoming opportunities to help you develop your professional, management \& supervisory skills.

jobs.description:
Assistant Town Planner / Code Enforcement Officer
JobID: 3037  

* + Position Type:  
	
	 Town of Plainville/Town Hall
	+ Date Posted:  
	
	 8/31/2026
	+ Location:  
	
	 Town of Plainville  

**WE'RE HIRING: ASSISTANT TOWN PLANNER / CODE ENFORCEMENT OFFICER**

 **Town of Plainville, Connecticut** \| **Location:** One Central Square, Plainville, CT

 **WHY PLAINVILLE?**


Nestled in the heart of Hartford County, Plainville offers a vibrant, supportive close\-knit community. Plainville is a place where neighbors connect and businesses thrive.


As part of our Municipal Team, you won't just enforce regulations, you will actively help to shape the sustainable growth, environmental health, and future landscape of our wonderful community.

 **WORK\-LIFE BALANCE AT PLAINVILLE**


We value your time inside and outside the office. This position offers an outstanding **4\-day work week (35\-hour salaried position)**, giving you dedicated, predictable three\-day weekends to rest, recharge, and enjoy everything central Connecticut has to offer! Attendance for evening Commission meetings as required.

 **POSITION OVERVIEW**


Working under the general direction of the Director of Planning \& Community Development and administrative supervision of the Town Manager, the **Assistant Town Planner / Code Enforcement Officer** administers Plainville's land use programs�including zoning, wetlands, subdivision, and aquifer protection regulations. You will serve as a vital link between the public, property developers, and municipal boards while managing GIS mapping and coordinating our Sustainable CT initiatives.

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


	+ **Regulatory Administration:** Review, manage, and inspect applications for zoning, wetlands, subdivisions, and aquifer protection to ensure compliance.
	+ **Community \& Board Support:** Serve as key technical staff for the Planning \& Zoning Commission, Conservation Commission, Inland Wetlands \& Watercourses Commission, and Zoning Board of Appeals (includes attendance at required evening meetings).
	+ **GIS \& Mapping:** Update and maintain the Town's zoning and wetlands maps using ESRI ArcGIS software; maintain land division inventories.
	+ **Field Inspections \& Enforcement:** Conduct site inspections (including in variable weather conditions), investigate property maintenance/blight complaints, and resolve violations diplomatically.
	+ **Leadership \& Sustainability:** Serve as Acting Director in the Director's absence and coordinate the Town's Sustainable CT program initiatives. **QUALIFICATIONS \& REQUIREMENTS**


	+ **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor's degree in planning, Geography, Public Administration, Environmental Science, or a related field, combined with 3�4 years of related work experience (or an equivalent combination of education and experience).
	+ **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in CT land use laws, site plan/blueprint interpretation, ESRI ArcGIS/ArcMap, MS Office, and Zoom.
	+ **Certifications:** Valid CT Driver's License (with personal vehicle for travel). Must obtain CT Association of Zoning Enforcement Officials (CAZEO) certification within 2 years of hire. *AICP certification preferred.*
	+ **Soft Skills:** Exceptional oral/written communication skills, diplomatic problem\-solving under public pressure, and strong organizational focus. **SALARY RANGE**


	+ **Expected Starting Salary Range:** $83,173\.56 � $93,569\.14 (Dependent on experience and qualifications)
	+ **Full Salary Range:** $83,173\.56 � $103,965\.70 (Grade 112\) (Reflects long\-term career growth within the role.) **HOW TO APPLY**

**Applications will be accepted on\-line through 4:00PM, Monday, September 21, 2026**. This position will remain open until filled.

 *The Town of Plainville is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

jobs.title: GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
**About the engagement**  
A state regulatory agency needs a spatial analysis of licensed delivery operations in a regulated market: where delivery service exists, where it does not, and which populations sit outside any current service area. The agency will use the resulting map to evaluate service area expansion requests and to identify underserved geography. The product becomes a standing tool the agency maintains after the engagement ends.

**What you would do**

* Geocode and validate licensed operator and delivery asset location data provided by the client
* Build service area layers using defensible assumptions, including drive\-time isochrones rather than simple radius buffers
* Overlay coverage against population, density, and relevant demographic geography to identify and quantify service gaps
* Produce an interactive web map that agency staff can use without desktop GIS software or a paid license
* Produce static, print\-quality map exhibits suitable for a report submitted to a state legislature
* Document data sources, projections, service area assumptions, and update procedures so agency staff can refresh the map in future cycles
* Deliver clean project files and layers in a format the client retains

**Required**

* Three or more years of applied GIS work with a portfolio of finished maps
* Proficiency with ArcGIS Pro or QGIS, and comfort producing web\-deliverable output (ArcGIS Online, Leaflet, Mapbox, Felt, or comparable)
* Geocoding and address validation experience with messy administrative data
* Network or drive\-time service area analysis experience
* Strong cartographic judgment. Output will be read by policymakers, not analysts
* Ability to document methods clearly enough for someone else to reproduce them
* Availability to deliver against fixed dates in November and December

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's or master's in geography, GIS, urban planning, public health, or a related field
* Experience with public sector or regulatory clients
* Python scripting for geoprocessing automation
* Experience with accessibility or service coverage analysis in any sector, including health care, transit, food access, or broadband

Pay: $65\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 35\.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: GIS Analyst II
jobs.description:
The purpose of this job is to lead and drive innovation, design, planning, and implementation of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and related applications. This position performs the most complex tasks involving GIS analysis, database design and management, system architecture, and application development. The role also includes project management responsibilities for planning and executing projects. Additionally, this position communicates complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to non\-technical GIS users.
  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities \- The intent of this job description is to provide a representative summary of the major duties and responsibilities performed by employees in this job. Employees may be requested to perform job\-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description**
* Performs complex data analysis using ArcGIS software, related extensions, relational databases, and other computer software.

  

* Designs, develops, and maintains GIS and relational databases in multiple formats to support organizational needs.

  

* Creates and implements custom GIS applications for both desktop and web environments.

  

* Collaborates with stakeholders to define requirements and deliver meaningful, data\-driven reports, maps, and visualizations.

  

* Leads team efforts to identify and implement effective approaches for project completion.

  

* Assists with project management activities.

  

* Communicates complex technical concepts clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, to non\-technical users.

  

* Provides coaching and technical training to staff.

  

* Creates and maintains technical records and standard operating procedures.

  

* Regular attendance is a necessary and essential function.

  

* Performs other duties as assigned

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
No supervisory authority. Work requires providing guidance and training to others. This position may oversee work quality, training, instructions, and work assignments.
  

**Human Collaboration and Job Impact \- This area describes the personal interaction with others outside direct reporting relationships as well as the impact the job has on organization, the department or unit objectives, the output of services, or employee or public satisfaction**
* Interactions and communications may result in recommendations regarding policy development and implementation. May also evaluate customer satisfaction, develop cooperative associations, and utilize resources to continuously improve customer satisfaction.

  

* Interactions have significant impact on the organization in terms of time, money, or public/employee relations.

  

**Fiscal Responsibility**
* Position has limited responsibility.

  

* May assist in the collection of data in support of recommendations for departmental budget allocations. May monitor work unit or program/promotional level budget and expenditures.

  

**Education and Experience \- An equivalent combination of education, training and experience will be considered**
**Education and Experience*** Bachelor’s Degree in Geography, Computer Science, GIS, or related filed.

  

* 5 to 7 years’ experience with enterprise GIS systems.


  

**Licenses or Certifications**
* Valid driver’s license

  

* Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) certification within one year of hire.

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities which may be representative, but not all\-inclusive of those commonly associated with this position**
**Knowledge of:*** ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, Python, JSON, XML, PowerShell, Structured Query Language (SQL) and Arcade.

  

* Experience Builder, Dashboards, Survey123 and Field Maps.

  

* Utility Network data model/framework.

  

* Imagery and LIDAR processing.

  

* Best practices and current trends in geospatial technologies, spatial databases, cartography and ADA compliance.

  

* Agile work methodologies.

 **Skill in:*** Communicating verbally and in writing to meet the needs of the audience.

  

* Applying active listening and asking questions for understanding.

  

* Collecting, organizing, and analyzing complex and/or technical data.

 **Ability to:*** Direct and perform high\-level GIS functions using multiple GIS software products – including ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Pro.

  

* Design data schemas, system integrations and ETL processes.

  

* Create and utilize networks, datasets, and programs for analysis, modelling and planning.

  

* Develop and maintain applications using technologies including ArcGIS Experience Builder, JavaScript, Python, Arcade and HTML.

  

* Compile, organize, interpret, and communicate data and results concisely.

  

* Apply logic and reasoning to evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

  

* Provide guidance and training to others.

  

* Provide high levels of effective customer service.

  

* Establish and maintain effective working relationships.

  

* Troubleshoot complex processes and systems.

  

* Identify and distinguish colors.

  

* Regularly use a computer, software, phone and related office equipment.

  

* Focus on tasks.

  

* Pass a Criminal Justice Information Services background check

**Work** **Environment:**  

Office or similar indoor environment – Frequently/Often

**Job Title: Senior Planning Officer**

**The Role**



Herefordshire Council are seeking to recruit a Senior Planning Officer (a permanent full\-time 37 hours per week post)



The successful applicant will be an ambitious town planner seeking to gain further experience within Development Management and take their career to the next level or someone with senior level experience simply looking to work in a beautiful part of the world and with a great team.


Read the full advert to understand how you could play a key role in shaping a sustainable and greener future for Herefordshire residents and its economy.


**What will you be doing?**



You will be based within one of the two area teams and the role will involve you in some of the more significant planning (and associated) applications that we deal with.



You will work within the beautiful Herefordshire countryside as well as dealing with casework within the city of Hereford and/or its surrounding market towns and villages.



The County is rich in biodiversity, landscape and heritage value including two National Landscapes, Conservation Areas and many listed building buildings. We think it\`s a truly outstanding place to work, that will offer the right candidate valuable experience in a wide range of casework and challenges, as well as an opportunity to shape a sustainable future as the Council embarks on the preparation of a new Local Plan.


**About You**



As a Senior Planning Officer you will have:


* An understanding of the role of a Senior Planning Officer in a local planning authority and demonstrable experience of dealing with a range of planning and other associated applications.
* Strong knowledge of planning policy, regulatory issues and current legislation.
* The ability to work under your own initiative as well as within a team, often to tight deadlines and on multiple work streams.
* Membership of or be or actively working towards membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute.
* A current full driving licence. Pool Cars are available for use.

new_jobs.title: GIS Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**About the engagement**  
A state regulatory agency needs a spatial analysis of licensed delivery operations in a regulated market: where delivery service exists, where it does not, and which populations sit outside any current service area. The agency will use the resulting map to evaluate service area expansion requests and to identify underserved geography. The product becomes a standing tool the agency maintains after the engagement ends.

**What you would do**

* Geocode and validate licensed operator and delivery asset location data provided by the client
* Build service area layers using defensible assumptions, including drive\-time isochrones rather than simple radius buffers
* Overlay coverage against population, density, and relevant demographic geography to identify and quantify service gaps
* Produce an interactive web map that agency staff can use without desktop GIS software or a paid license
* Produce static, print\-quality map exhibits suitable for a report submitted to a state legislature
* Document data sources, projections, service area assumptions, and update procedures so agency staff can refresh the map in future cycles
* Deliver clean project files and layers in a format the client retains

**Required**

* Three or more years of applied GIS work with a portfolio of finished maps
* Proficiency with ArcGIS Pro or QGIS, and comfort producing web\-deliverable output (ArcGIS Online, Leaflet, Mapbox, Felt, or comparable)
* Geocoding and address validation experience with messy administrative data
* Network or drive\-time service area analysis experience
* Strong cartographic judgment. Output will be read by policymakers, not analysts
* Ability to document methods clearly enough for someone else to reproduce them
* Availability to deliver against fixed dates in November and December

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's or master's in geography, GIS, urban planning, public health, or a related field
* Experience with public sector or regulatory clients
* Python scripting for geoprocessing automation
* Experience with accessibility or service coverage analysis in any sector, including health care, transit, food access, or broadband

Pay: $65\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 35\.0 per week

Work Location: Remote
